source.author: ov
source.text: Ergo maestissimus altum aethera conscendit vultuque sequentia traxit nubila, quis nimbos immixtaque fulgura ventis addidit et tonitrus et inevitabile fulmen.
source.text_original: Ergo maestissimus altum / aethera conscendit vultuque sequentia traxit / nubila, quis nimbos immixtaque fulgura ventis / addidit et tonitrus et inevitabile fulmen.
source.text_english: Therefore, most sorrowful, he ascended the lofty sky and with his face drew the clouds along after him, to which he added rainstorms and lightning mingled with winds, and thunder, and the unavoidable thunderbolt.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat tempestas.
reuse.text_original: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, / has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat / tempestas.
reuse.text_english: Acamans dwells in that place, and naked Pyragmon too; these homes are preserved by storms and winds and by shipwrecking tempest.
